title: Study Materials
text:
All you need to do is spend 20 minutes each day watching the video. That’s it.
If you want some extra practice, you can also try the exercises provided in the exercise file.
The goal is simple: get familiar with Python, build some confidence, and take the first step towards learning a useful skill.

Day 1.1: Installing Python
In this video, you’ll see how to download and install Python on a Windows computer, set up the environment correctly, and launch Jupyter Notebook without any confusion. This guide is perfect if you’re completely new to programming, data science, or Python development.
We’ll cover:

Downloading and installing Python on Windows
Setting up PATH and verifying installation
Installing Jupyter Notebook using pip
Opening Jupyter Notebook for the first time
Creating and running your first notebook

By the end of this tutorial, you’ll have a fully working Python setup and be ready to start coding in Jupyter Notebook.

title: About
text:
Python Jumpstart is a short, self-paced learning series created in response to students’ feedback and requests to learn Python.
Although Python is not currently included in the curriculum, having basic Python skills has become increasingly valuable in the job market, particularly in data analysis, data science, and related fields. This course is designed to give students a simple and practical starting point without adding pressure to their regular studies.
The idea is simple: spend just 20 minutes a day during your study leave.
You don’t need to become a Python expert in five days. The goal is to build familiarity, confidence, and motivation to continue learning. Each day introduces a small set of concepts and practical examples that you can work through at your own pace.
20 minutes a day. 5 days. One small step towards learning Python.
Start small. Code a little. Keep learning. 🐍
Dr Thiyanga S. Talagala
